note: AGL is DSM - DTM from LiDAR, so it is ground truth, not a prediction.

agl_consistency.identity: DTM + AGL == DSM wherever DSM >= DTM; elsewhere AGL is clipped to 0
agl_consistency.ground_agreement_note: 25th percentile of DSM-DTM; a robust stand-in for open ground. Near 0 means the two products agree there.
